description: The graph around one memory file, up to three hops. Depth 1: the files, skills, agents and servers it links to or is linked from, its folder, type, project and tags, and links that land on nothing (→ links to (missing) name). From depth 2 on only links out of a file reached by a link are followed: a backlink, folder, type, project or tag is listed at depth 1 and never walked through. Pick the depth yourself; 1 is the default and usually enough, 2-3 follow a chain of links further, the files most of the previous depth links to first. Grouped by depth; each line names the edge and, from depth 2, the node it was reached through. types, folder and project narrow what is listed, not the walk.

folder.description: Only memory files and folders under this folder (full path, or its last part).

path.description: Path of the memory file to start from.

project.description: Only nodes about this project (and the project itself).

types.description: Comma-separated node kinds to list: memory, skill, agent, mcp, tool, folder, type, project, tag, collection.

name: memory_graph
title: Walk the memory graph
